Trace, implement and test: 1)Merge Strings Alternately

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution(object):
    def mergeAlternately(self, word1, word2):
        """
        :type word1: str
        :type word2: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        res = ""
        isl1 = True
        l1 = 0
        l2 = 0

        while l1 < len(word1) or l2 < len(word2):
            if isl1:
                if l1 < len(word1):
                    res+= word1[l1]
                    l1+=1
                else:
                    res+= word2[l2]
                    l2+=1
                isl1 = False
            else:
                if l2 < len(word2):
                    res+= word2[l2]
                    l2+=1
                else:
                    res += word1[l1]
                    l1+=1
                isl1 = True

        return res
